APO 500
10 February 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of a Suspected War Criminal.
The following-named Japanese will be apprehended as a Suspected War Criminal and delivered to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp) at the earliest possible date.
NAME RANK OR TITLE PERTINENT DATA
SUZUKI, Yutaka Sub Lt (IJN) 25 Special Naval Base Force, Kokas, Dutch NG, Jan/Apr 44 - Nov 44/ Aug 45. Probable home address: #2463 Mitsuke, Iwata-cho, Iwata-gun, Shizuoka-ken.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
